blocks.content: Added to the plan. The HUD is well set up for this: the HUD slice already tracks unread separately in `attentionByWorkspaceId` (from `workspace:attention-changed`), and the card already has a blink animation used for attention:

I updated the cloudlands-fe task (still held behind the intentd task, so the implementor will pick this up when it starts) to:

- Retire `unread` as a HUD card state entirely (`HUD_CARD_STATE_KEYS` / `toHudCardStateKey`) — the card banner always shows the real state (e.g. COMPLETE).
- Add a **blue border blink** (`HUD_STATE_COLORS.unread`) when `workspace.attention === 'unread'`, exactly analogous to the yellow attention blink, with attention taking precedence, unread staying passive for takeovers, and the `prefers-reduced-motion` guard respected.

The spec's acceptance criteria now include this HUD behavior. Meanwhile the intentd and iOS agents are still working; the fe task starts once intentd settles. I'll report back at settlement.
